'''Mart Stevez''' was a member of the [[Atrisian Assault Corps|Atrisian Royal Corps]] and later the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] his whole family while he was on a training mission. They claimed that his father had become politically unstable and needed to be removed. Stevez then became a respected member of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. He was eventually promoted to the rank of [[Major/Legends|Major]], and he was given command of [[Taskforce Shen]]. He led Taskforce Shen in many successful missions throughout the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
